migrationTool: Flyway or Liquibase for schema + custom ETL for data

phases.name: Schema Preparation
phases.description: Review generated DDL, resolve HIGH/CRITICAL risk columns, add missing PKs.
steps: Run: python migration_plan.py engagement.json --target azure-postgresql
Review schema.sql for HIGH/CRITICAL risk columns
Add surrogate PKs to tables flagged with no primary key
Confirm NUMERIC precision with business stakeholders for packed decimal fields

phases.name: Target Schema Deployment
phases.description: Deploy schema.sql to the azure-postgresql instance.
steps: Create target database on azure-postgresql
Run: psql -h <host> -U <user> -d <db> -f schema.sql
Verify all tables created: SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public'

phases.name: Data Migration
phases.description: Migrate data from unknown to azure-postgresql using the recommended tool.
phases.tool: Flyway or Liquibase for schema + custom ETL for data
steps: Configure Flyway or Liquibase for schema + custom ETL for data
Run initial full-load migration
Validate row counts per table
Run parity checks on HIGH-risk columns (packed decimal, date fields)

phases.name: ORM & Application Cutover
phases.description: Update application ORM configuration to point to the new database.
steps: Replace existing ORM provider with generated orm-config/ files
Update connection string in appsettings.json / application.yml / database.py
Run application integration tests against the new database
Enable CDC dual-write for shared kernel tables

phases.name: Cutover & Validation
phases.description: Switch production traffic to the new database. Validate parity.
phases.tool: Bidirectional CDC Guardrail skill + differential-golden-run-comparator skill
steps: Enable bidirectional CDC for zero-downtime cutover
Run differential-golden-run-comparator skill for parity validation
Shift 10% traffic canary to new database
Monitor for 24h, then shift 100%
Decommission source database after 30-day observation period
